'''Leevan Tenza''' was a laconic [[Sabat]] [[Gender|male]] who served under [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[5 BBY]], he was arrested by the Alliance after disobeying an order and attacking an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] target too early, but rather than face [[court-martial]] he escaped custody and joined up with [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]].

Tenza prove better suited to life in the Partisans and proved an efficient member, especially when using his [[DH-447 sniper rifle]]. In [[1 BBY]], he was stationed in the the Partisans [[Catacombs of Cadera|base]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]], when a group of captive Alliance agents were imprisoned there. The Partisans were then forced to flee when their base was destroyed by a blast wave from the [[Destruction of Jedha City]] by the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].

==Biography==
[[File:Beezer Fortuna and Leevan Tenza.png|thumb|Beezer Fortuna and Leevan Tenza in Jedha City]]
In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="GeektionaryDate">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' states that Leevan Tenza left the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] five [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to [[5 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Therefore, Tenza must have left in 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].</ref> the Sabat [[Soldier|warrior]] Leevan Tenza was serving in the Alliance to Restore the Republic<ref name="Geektionary" /> as part of the team under [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]],<ref name="ROUVG" /> which was known as the [[Massassi Group]],<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> when Tenza disobeyed orders to attack an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] target earlier than intended. The Sabat was then placed under arrest by the Alliance for the disobedience and, facing a [[court-martial]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> he escaped rebel custody to join up with the Partisans led by the freedom fighter Saw Gerrera.<ref name="ROUVG" /> Tenza made a name for himself by aligning with the Partisans,<ref name="AlienArchive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> and was not the only one who had defected from the Alliance, although his motive was different from most who had chosen to become more radical in their resistance against the Empire.<ref name="Geektionary" />

Later in 5 BBY,<ref name="Andor-Date">{{AndorDate|111}}</ref> Tenza and the Partisans were stationed at a [[Saw Gerrera's Base|base]] on<ref name="Narkina 5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> the [[planet]]<ref name="Narkina 5 AD">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> [[Segra Milo]]. Tenza stood in the base while the rebel [[Luthen Rael]] spoke with Gerrera inside.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref>

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="RODate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events on [[Jedha]] in ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Tenza was amongst the Partisans stationed with Gerrera in the [[Catacombs of Cadera]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]].<ref name="ROUVG" /> Shortly after a group of Alliance agents were captured in [[Jedha City]] and imprisoned in the catacombs, Tenza was quietly playing a "homemade" variant of [[dejarik]] on a table near the cells where the prisoners were being kept. After one of the three [[human]] Partisans sat at the table with him rolled a set of dice, Tenza raised his hands in the air and cried out as the others cheered.<ref name="RO" />

He then moved to another part of the catacombs and was stood at a terminal as the Alliance agent [[Jyn Erso]] was escorted through the room on her way to see Gerrera. The Partisans were then forced to evacuate the catacombs and flee when the structure was destroyed by the blast wave generated by the Empire's [[destruction of Jedha City]] using the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="RO" /> While some Partisans did escape with their lives, others,<ref name="SW39">[[Star Wars (2015) 39|''Star Wars'' (2015) 39]]</ref> including Gerrera, perished in the blast.<ref name="RO" /> At some point an [[Unidentified artist|artist]] mentioned Tenza in his [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], including a depiction of the Partisan as an example of the Sabat species.<ref name="AlienArchive" />

==Personality and traits==
Leevan Tenza was a defiant and laconic individual who embraced his guilt rather than declaring his innocence when he was arrested by the Alliance for disobeying an order.<ref name="ROUVG" /> He was better suited to life amongst the more casually organization of the Partisans and proved to be a particularly efficient member, especially when using his [[DH-447 sniper rifle]]. His casual terseness was put to the test when he came to fully understand that the blast wave from the [[Death Star]]'s attack was headed toward the catacombs.<ref name="Geektionary" /> He had [[Color|pink]] skin and gray [[hair]].<ref name="RO" />

==Equipment==
[[File:LeevanTenza-SWZ.png|thumb|left|250px|Leevan Tenza flew a T-65B X-Wing starfighter for the Partisans.]]
While in the catacombs, Tenza wore a light brown [[Clothing|jacket]] over a dark brown shirt with a black and red [[kama]] and brown pants. He also wore black and red fingerless [[glove]]s, black [[boot]]s and a series of brown [[bandolier]]s and [[belt]]s full of ammunition. He chewed on a toothpick while playing dejarik<ref name="RO" /> and carried a DH-447 [[sniper rifle]] with a [[supercollimator barrel]].<ref name="ROUVG" /> Tenza also sometimes flew a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] for the Partisans<ref name="FFG">{{FFGXW2|set=Saw's Renegades Expansion Pack|cardname=Leevan Tenza}}</ref> which bore the colors of the [[Cavern Angels]] [[squadron]].<ref name="CavernAngels">{{FFGXW|set=Saw's Renegades Expansion Pack|cardname=Cavern Angels Zealot}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Leevan Tenza first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology film]], ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. The character was played by creature performer<ref name="RO" /> [[Dilu Miah]].<ref name="Leevan">{{Instagram|username=dilu.tricks|url=p/BQs60DqlMRx|name=Dilu Miah|date=2017-02-19|quote=Lee vanTenza the most badass alien who I was lucky enough to play on Rogue One: A Star Wars Story 😋😋 do you feel lucky...huh punk!|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/fF9Xe}}</ref> He was not named in the film,<ref name="RO" /> but received identification in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="ROUVG" /> According to Hidalgo, Tenza's production name was "Lee Van Teef," which was a reference to the actor [[Wikipedia:Lee Van Cleef|Lee Van Cleef]].<ref name="Production Name">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1725186648479338520|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2023-11-16|quote=That's Leevan Tenza reacting to the game. His production name was Lee Van Teef, a clear reference to Lee Van Cleef. For the Guide, I softened it a bit by combining Lee + Van, and using Sentenza (from TG,TB & TU) as the source of his surname.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/FRQHp}}</ref>
